data.body: Phase 2 closeout disposition: this A6-0d prep ticket is obsolete because the reclaim execution ticket wormy-tamed-johndory has already closed with an operator-attested completion-verifier disposition, and the reclaim protocol it records includes deleting the pre-rewrite ref pins, creating/verifying the off-repo bundle, and checking no default-fetched ref retains the old tip. Reopening this as standalone prep work would repeat an already-consumed pre-window step rather than complete residual epic scope.
